# coval_alert (Data Source)

Retrieves a Coval alert by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_alert" "low_resolution" {
  id = "01HZ0EXAMPLE00000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Alert ULID.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `agent_ids` (Set of String)
- `channels` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Public API notification channel objects.
- `conditions` (Dynamic) Public API condition objects.
- `conversation_source` (String)
- `cooldown_seconds` (Number)
- `create_time` (String)
- `custom_message_template` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `evaluation_type` (String)
- `last_triggered_at` (String)
- `match_mode` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `required_tags` (Set of String)
- `scheduled_run_ids` (Set of String)
- `status` (String)
- `trigger_count` (Number)
- `update_time` (String)
